reviews.title: Hot Pink, Cool Vibes
reviews.comment: I love this cooler! I got it for my wife for their new PC build. It lowered the temps to 60-70 degrees and works perfectly with the look we were going for. The infinity mirror effect is GOREGOUS.

reviews.title: Works great looks cool
reviews.comment: AIO has performed great so far. Keeping the CPU nice and cool. Don’t make the same mistake as I did and ensure you have the clearance in your case were you want to install . Luckily with a small modification to my case I was able to install.

reviews.title: Good value cooler in pink and white
reviews.comment: Great cooler for the price. Put it in my wife's extremely small mATX case to cool a ryzen 7 5800x and temps under load have been in mid 60s.
